limits: Test B's partner channel is PPI + complex co-membership only. Genes with no such partner fall back to the global mean, so B's headroom is bounded by partner-graph coverage, which is reported above and is NOT uniform across genes
co-dependency is deliberately absent from B and C. That is not a modelling choice, it is the only way the test is non-circular, and it means B is strictly harder than a co-dependency model would look
the gene feature table is annotation, not sequence. No ESM/structure channel is used, so a null in B bounds what THESE features recover and not what sequence could
Test C pairs gene block b with line block b mod N_LINE_BLOCKS rather than running the full cartesian product, so its n is the number of gene blocks and not their product

both train and test cells are SUBSAMPLED (caps ABC_N_TRAIN / ABC_N_TEST) and the counts actually used are printed per regime; RMSE is therefore a Monte-Carlo estimate over that sample, not the exact value over every held-out cell
DepMap gene effect is Chronos-scaled and already corrects for copy number and screen quality; a residual batch structure across screens is not removed here
verdict: SMOKE RUN -- a plumbing check and NOT a result; rerun with ABC_SMOKE unset. TEST A vs B vs C. Test A (unseen cell line, every gene seen) reaches RMSE 0.1659 against a MARGINAL-both of 0.1603. Test B (unseen GENE, every line seen) has the per-gene lookup available for 0.0% of its test genes by construction, and the best non-lookup model reaches 0.3347 against a GLOBAL-mean of 0.4117. Test C (unseen gene AND unseen line) reaches 0.3391 against 0.4110. THE HEADLINE IS THE RETAINED FRACTION: Test A's learned gain over its own marginal is -0.0056 RMSE, and Test B retains -1369.9% of it. CO-DEPENDENCY PARTNERS ARE FORBIDDEN IN B AND C and are not used there: selecting them requires the held-out gene's own DepMap column, which is the label. The partner channel in B and C is PPI and complex co-membership only, and the DepMap-derived gene fields ['dep_frac', 'ess', 'ess_src'] are excluded from the feature matrix with an assertion rather than a comment. All effect sizes are raw held-out RMSE; controls establish significance and attribution and nothing is reported net of a control.
log: TESTS A / B / C -- unseen line, unseen gene, and both. The universal-generalisation test.
